description:
Short title
self assessment

What should the AI do?
help me write my end of year self-assessment for my manager

Where will it be used?
Business functions (HR, finance, IT, sales, legal)

Does the AI output directly affect a batch, a GMP record, a QC result, a release or a process setting?
No, only indirectly. its for HR

What kind of AI is it?
Generative AI: writes or creates text, images or code (LLM). you, or chatgpt

What happens with the output?
A trained person checks and approves each output before it is used. i will edit it before i send it

Who checks the output, and how?
me, then my manager reads it

What data goes into it?
Personal data

Who provides it?
Cloud or online service
